title: Five to ten agentic additions to a system you already have
purpose: List AI/agentic additions to a real system, each tied to what users need.
why: A system that already runs is the fastest proof. Adding agent reliability, human approval, tool integration, or observability turns it into evidence of exactly what applied-AI roles hire for.
evidence: A list of 5–10 ideas, each tied to something you read while commenting.

tasks.title: List 5–10 possible AI/agentic additions (reliability, approval, tool/API integration, evals, regulated workflow)
tasks.done_when: Each idea says what it adds and why a user would care.
